tools.name: telegram_status
tools.description: Report Telegram bot runtime status for the active chat, including session count, memory mode, polling or webhook mode, and rate limit state.

tools.name: telegram_send_file
tools.description: Send a local file to the current Telegram chat. Use this when a report, dossier, chart, document, archive, or other generated file should be delivered to the user.

file_path.description: Absolute path, relative path, or configured path alias for the local file to send.

tools.name: telegram_session_info
tools.description: Report current Telegram session metadata such as turn count, message count, memory mode, session start time, and active uploaded file.
